description: Trims a clip (and its linked audio/video) to new SOURCE in/out points, or to a timeline duration, keeping every remaining frame where it was on the timeline. Snaps to the frame grid, refuses trims past the media or into a neighbour, and restores the clip if Premiere does not apply the edit.

clipId.description: The ID of the clip on the timeline to trim

duration.description: Alternative: set the desired timeline duration in seconds; cannot be combined with outPoint

inPoint.description: The new in point in seconds from the start of the clip

outPoint.description: The new out point in seconds from the start of the clip; cannot be combined with duration

name: trim_clip
